title: glowed configuration
description: Configuration for the glowed terminal Markdown browser/editor.

$schema.description: JSON schema path for editor autocomplete/validation.

prefix.description: Prefix key used before prefixKeys actions.

keys.description: Direct key bindings. These work without pressing prefix first.

prefixKeys.description: Prefix key bindings. Press prefix first, then one of these keys.

style.description: Glamour style name or JSON style path.

preserveNewLines.description: Preserve markdown newlines in rendered preview.

actions.description: Actions shown in the footer action bar. Footer items are clickable.

maxFileBytes.description: Skip markdown files larger than this many bytes.

enabled.description: Enable the external LLM session launcher.

command.description: External CLI command to launch, e.g. claude, codex, aider, or a wrapper script.

terminalCommand.description: Terminal command used to open the external LLM session.

terminalApp.description: macOS application name for AppleScript/open when terminalCommand is Ghostty.

openMode.description: How to open the external LLM session. On macOS Ghostty, split-* uses Ghostty AppleScript to split the current window.

maxContextBytes.description: Maximum current-file markdown bytes sent as chat context.

includeCurrentFile.description: Include current markdown content in initial LLM context. Default is false: path plus optional selection only.

includeSelection.description: Include selected original markdown when an app-managed selection exists.

key.description: Key string as reported by Bubble Tea, e.g. q, /, tab, enter, ctrl+s, ctrl+g. User-friendly aliases such as ctrl+space are accepted and normalized to ctrl+@.
